{{Quote|These chambers and tunnels are my Empire.|The [[Meatlump King]]|<ref name="SWG:MtM" />}}
The '''Coronet Maintenance Tunnels''' were a series of underground tunnels located beneath the surface of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], the capital city of the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Overview==
The Coronet Maintenance Tunnels were inhospitable tunnels and rooms mostly populated by utilitarian droids, such as [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droids]], [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droids]], [[R5-series astromech droid]]s and [[blastromech droid]]s.<ref name="SWG:DAD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy All Droids|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="SWG:DNSD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy Non-Security Droids|Corellia}}</ref> The area was also infested with rodents such as [[meetle]]s and [[worrmp]]s.<ref name="SWG:WO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Wine-O}}</ref>

===Lower Maintenance Areas===
{{Quote|Go get rid of those droids. The lower levels are full of them. They give me the creeps...being so close to us.|[[Dorvin Kanu]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DAD" />}}
[[File:Lower_Maintenance_Areas_Coronet_02.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Lower Maintenance Areas.]]
The '''Lower Maintenance Areas''' were the deepest and most dangerous levels of the Coronet Maintenance Tunnels. Although they were patrolled by [[S-1 security droid|S-1]] and [[S-2 security droid]]s of the [[Corellian Security Force]], criminals and thugs used to prowl the area.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==History==
{{Quote|After an exhaustive, and exhausting, search, the hideout of the Meatlumps was discovered. They have made themselves a home in some abandoned maintenance tunnels beneath Coronet. It is there that they are hidden away from the eyes of the galaxy.|[[Vani Korr]], in ''[[Who are the Meatlumps?]]''|<ref name="SWG:acoVKsMa">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|a copy of Vani Korr's second Meatlump article}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the anti-technology fanatics of the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump gang]] had established their [[Meatlump Hideout|secret hideout]] in an abandoned portion of the Coronet maintenance tunnels. The [[Meatlump King]], the fabled leader of the Meatlumps, held court there for his followers. The Meatlumps managed to keep their hideout secret until its location was discovered by the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Vani Korr]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:MtM" />

The Meatlumps used to raid the Lower Maintenance Areas, located just beneath the Meatlump Hideout, in order to plunder all the supplies they could find there.<ref name="SWG:FtMS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Missing Supplies|Corellia}}</ref> They sometimes clashed with the droids operating in the area but tried to avoid attracting the attention of the [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]].<ref name="SWG:DAD" /><ref name="SWG:DNSD" /> Meatlump operations in the Lower Maintenance Areas were supervised by [[Decider]] [[Ximo Tacx]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dorvin Kanu]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Loman Vosso]] and Lieutenant [[Cyru Sarkee]].<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer rescued a Meatlump who was trapped in the Lower Maintenance Areas by a group of [[Ragtags]].<ref name="SWG:RtLM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Rescue the Lost Meatlump|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Coronet Maintenance Tunnels were a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Coronet Maintenance Tunnels were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]", introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
